ax:
- main:
  - heading "Celestia" [level=1]
  - paragraph: An independent project for exploring Zi Wei Dou Shu charts.
  - region "Check birth inputs":
    - heading "Check birth inputs" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Check the date, time, and timezone formats here. Chart calculation is not available, and additional chart inputs have not yet been defined.
    - paragraph: These entries stay in this page’s memory. They are not sent, saved, or logged by Celestia.
    - form "Check birth inputs":
      - group "Birth details — all fields are required":
        - text: Birth details — all fields are required
        - alert:
          - paragraph: Correct 1 field and check again.
          - list:
            - listitem:
              - 'link "Birth location timezone: Enter the birth location’s IANA timezone, for example Asia/Taipei, or UTC."':
                - /url: "#timeZone"
        - text: Birth date (Gregorian) (required)
        - paragraph: Use YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2000-02-29. Lunar dates are not supported by this form.
        - textbox "Birth date (Gregorian) (required)":
          - /placeholder: YYYY-MM-DD
          - text: 2000-01-15
        - text: Local birth time (required)
        - paragraph: Use 24-hour HH:mm, for example 14:30. Enter the clock time at the birth location.
        - textbox "Local birth time (required)":
          - /placeholder: HH:mm
          - text: 14:30
        - text: Birth location timezone (required)
        - paragraph: Enter an IANA timezone such as Asia/Taipei or America/Los_Angeles, or UTC. No timezone is chosen automatically.
        - textbox "Birth location timezone (required)" [invalid]:
          - /placeholder: Asia/Taipei
        - paragraph: Enter the birth location’s IANA timezone, for example Asia/Taipei, or UTC.
        - button "Check inputs"
      - status

fields.label: Birth date (Gregorian) (required)
